login.title: Welcome back.
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your workspaces.

register.title: Create your account.

register.termsAgree: I agree to the <terms>terms of service</terms> and confirm having read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

success.title: Check your inbox.
success.description: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.

loading.title: Verifying your email...

success.title: Email verified.
success.description: Your address is confirmed, you can now sign in.

handleVisibilityHint: Visible to other members of your team.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.

success.title: Check your inbox.
success.description: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent a password reset link.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

success.title: Password reset.
success.description: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.

error.title: Reset link unavailable
error.missingToken: This link is missing its reset token.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the code generated by your authenticator app.

side.title: The HQ for your <ember>CTFs</ember> and your red team.
side.description: Organise challenges, writeups and teammates in one clear space, from solo grinding to a 48h CTF.

workspaces.title: Dedicated workspaces
workspaces.description: One space per platform or CTF (HTB, THM, CTFtime...) with its challenges, tags and permissions.

kanban.title: Challenge kanban
kanban.description: From "to do" to "solved", assign teammates and categorise with system or custom tags.

writeups.title: Markdown writeups
writeups.description: Split Markdown / preview editor, private drafts or published to the team, attachments included.

realtime.title: Real-time dashboard
realtime.description: The activity feed shows who solved what and which flags land, live during the event.

teams.title: Teams & invitations
teams.description: Invitation links, Owner / Admin / Member / Viewer roles and workspace linking.

stats.title: Detailed statistics
stats.description: Progress by category, difficulty, team velocity and personal stats.

validation.usernamePattern: Letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or a digit
validation.passwordComposition: At least one digit and one symbol
